title: Independence declaration — BASELINE-001
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This file confers no authority and states no rule. It names which instruments BASELINE-001's surfaces must be verified AGAINST, and where the reviewed templates for those surfaces live.
$why_pointers: Every field below is a POINTER into an instrument that already holds the list, never a
copy of it. UCKP-ART-03 makes a second authoring of the same knowledge void, so adopting
the framework may not require restating data that baseline.json or the registry already declares.

$why_suffix: A RECORD FILE CANNOT BE ITS OWN PROVENANCE. baseline.json is declared above as an
AUTHORITY — it holds the measured records the seven prose surfaces project — and the
registry also lists it as a generated artifact, so without this filter it was checked
as a surface against a corpus that contains itself.
That check was vacuous where it was not nonsense: every string in the file is in the
corpus by construction, and the 930 lines it reported were JSON syntax — `},` and
`"id": "...",` — classified as prose in no manifest. Not one of them named a defect,
and 930 of 1,127 findings is a report nobody can read.
The pointer is kept rather than replaced by a list of the seven surfaces: a new
generated projection is picked up here with no edit, which is the property that stops
a surface from escaping verification by being added quietly.
